reviews.title: one stick stopped working.
reviews.comment:
One of the two ram sticks won't work after 2 months. I spent at least 12 hours troubleshooting. One stick or ram works with no errors in slot A2 and B2. The other ram stick will always get errors and keeps getting worse. Something is wearing out. It used to kind of work, I set it from the XMP1 7000MT/s settings you guys have on the chip back to JDEC 4800MT/s and it kinda works for a bit and then crashes windows with one of many memory errors.
Really hoping they can replace this or RMA it. Even with XMP disabled and running slow JDEC 4800 the error rate is the same or worse with the bad stick. The other stick can do anything. Tried both individually in both slots. One stick works the other doesn't after literally weeks.
